title: Quality of Life Effect: When Better Packaging Supports Better Pet Care

body_markdown:
[Read the Report Now](https://www.sonoco.com/sites/default/files/images/PDFs/Quality%20of%20Life_Market%20Brief_%20Pet_Sonoco_2026.pdf)


For millions of Americans, pets are family. The pet care industry reached $158 billion in the U.S. in 2025 with continued, steady growth expected for 2026.


New research commissioned by Sonoco explores the "pets-as-family" mindset and its impact on purchasing decisions. The report examines the bond between people and pets, the role nutrition plays and how packaging can preserve freshness, product integrity and everyday convenience for pet owners.


### **How Pets Are Viewed as Family**


Today, researchers are uncovering evidence that helps explain why the relationships between animals and people feel so meaningful. Studies in the report suggest that pets can recognize visual and verbal cues, respond to human emotions and build strong social bonds with the people who care for them. These connections can have a meaningful impact on mental wellness, an increasingly important part of our overall well-being.


### **Why Food Matters and Packaging Does Too**


Just as nutrition contributes to a pet's overall well-being, packaging plays an important role in preserving freshness, protecting nutrients and maintaining product integrity throughout its shelf life. Convenient, easy-to-use packaging can also simplify feeding routines and enhance the experience of owning a pet.


### **How Sonoco Works to Improve Packaging Quality**


Through a broad range of sustainable packaging solutions, from steel food cans to paper canisters, Sonoco helps pet food brands deliver quality products to consumers while supporting recyclability and responsible material use.


Beyond packaging innovation, the company also supports animal welfare and sustainability initiatives that help strengthen the broader pet care ecosystem. Learn more about these efforts, key findings and insights in Sonoco's[The Quality of Life](https://www.sonoco.com/sites/default/files/images/PDFs/Quality%20of%20Life_Market%20Brief_%20Pet_Sonoco_2026.pdf) Effect report.
